title: Refrigerator pickles versus shelf-stable pickles
summary: Do not confuse a refrigerated acidified recipe with a processed shelf-stable product.
steps: Choose a current tested recipe and identify whether it is refrigerator-only or designed for canning.
Use the exact vinegar acidity, food amounts and jar size specified; do not dilute or alter proportions.
For refrigerator pickles, cool and keep continuously refrigerated for the stated period.
For shelf-stable pickles, use the complete heat-processing method and altitude adjustment in the tested recipe.
Discard jars with failed seals, leakage, spurting, mould or uncertain processing.
